method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Molossidae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (6 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only molossids are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

remaps.note: This is a genus transfer, not a split. An iNaturalist taxa search for the exact 2011 spelling Chaerephon pumila returned 0 results. A search for the printed synonym Tadarida pumila matches Mops pumilus (taxon 1370990), which lists Tadarida pumila and Chaerephon pumilus as invalid scientific names, but not the 2011 spelling Chaerephon pumila.

An iNaturalist taxa search for the exact 2011 spelling Mops condylus returned 0 results. A search for the printed synonym Tadarida condylura matches Mops condylurus (taxon 765544), which lists Tadarida condylura as an invalid scientific name, but not the 2011 spelling Mops condylus. This is treated as a spelling correction of the 2011 combination, supported by the printed synonym, not as a species-level guess.

An iNaturalist taxa search for that trinomial returns only the species Tadarida aegyptiaca (taxon 41300, preferred_common_name Egyptian Free-tailed Bat). No subspecies taxon for T. a. aegyptiaca was present in that search or on the species record. The stored taxon is therefore the species, and the research-grade count is the species total.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

Searches for the exact 2011 spellings Chaerephon pumila and Mops condylus, and for the printed synonym Nyctinomus mastersoni, returned 0 results. Remaps for those taxa rest on the printed synonyms that iNaturalist does list (Tadarida pumila, Tadarida condylura, and Tadarida mastersoni). Those missing exact-spelling links are logged.

The 2011 list already uses the nominotypical subspecies Tadarida aegyptiaca aegyptiaca, but iNaturalist has no such subspecies taxon. The stored taxon is the species T. aegyptiaca, which has 0 research-grade and 11 observations of any grade at species rank.

Five of the six official molossids have 0 research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020 (only Mops pumilus has 1). Tadarida fulminans is also absent from the place taxonomy tree. Absence of an iNat record was not treated as absence from KNP.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Molossidae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
